lead.headline: Minnesota raise two receivers and still say nothing on Jefferson; Monangai stays off injured reserve
lead.deck: Saturday's roster moves are in. None changes a status on your team, and none changes a move: three names to read on Sunday's inactive lists.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players. Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison are both still questionable at half past six Eastern, and Minnesota spent the afternoon elevating two receivers, Odell Beckham Jr. and Jeshaun Jones. Neither starter was downgraded, and ESPN's Kevin Seifert says Jefferson's availability 'has yet to be determined'; a club that is sure of both does not usually raise two. Kyle Monangai is out with turf toe, in a boot, and Chicago did not put him on injured reserve, which is the least bad version of that news. Terry McLaurin is still a game-time decision, now on a field forecast to take an inch of rain. You are 0–4 and trail 31.5 to nothing; ESPN gives you 45%, unchanged. Around your roster: Pittsburgh raised a third running back, and the beat projects Rico Dowdle inactive, which would leave Jaylen Warren the backfield again. Stefon Diggs was dropped by a rival and sits on waivers until Wednesday; Mack Hollins went on injured reserve, which makes Romeo Doubs's larger share four games long. Both are Tuesday's business. Nothing needs doing today, and tomorrow's edition is written before the 09:30 inactive lists, so the two cards below are yours to fire.
